_comment_setup: === AZURE PORTAL SETUP – Folgende Werte müssen ersetzt werden ===
1. client_id:    Azure Portal → App registrations → Deine App → Application (client) ID
2. redirect_uri: Azure Portal → App registrations → Authentication → Add a platform → Android
Befehl: keytool -exportcert -alias androiddebugkey -keystore ~/.android/debug.keystore | openssl sha1 -binary | openssl base64
3. tenant_id:    Deine Tenant-ID (Single Tenant – nur dein Firmen-Account)
Azure Portal → Azure Active Directory → Overview → Tenant ID
4. Azure-Registrierung: Supported account types → 'Accounts in this organizational directory only'
